facts.fact: Jembi reports that interoperability between the civil registration system e-SiRCEV and the hospital births module MGDH-births launched on 22 July 2024, after an Inhambane Province start in April and May 2024 that takes birth-registering facilities there from five to nineteen, with nationwide expansion planned.

systems.system: e-SiRCEV (Electronic Civil Registration and Vital Statistics System)
MGDH-births (Hospital Data Management Module for Births Registration)

systems.owner: Government of Mozambique with Jembi Health Systems and Saudigitus
systems.tiers: hospitals to civil registration, Inhambane first
